title: Energy Gurus Crm
shortDescription: Overview:
fullDescription:
Overview:

An enterprise-grade Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and operations platform tailored for solar energy companies (EnergyGurus). The platform streamlines end-to-end solar lifecycle operations—from lead onboarding and multi-tier technical profiling to a 3-stage managerial approval pipeline, dynamic billing and ledger adjustments, automated ticket escalations, and inventory tracking.

Key Highlights & Architecture Unified Customer & Solar Technical Profiling: 

Centralized customer records indexed by numeric IDs and standardized CRF numbers, capturing granular technical solar assets (DISCO, Net Metering specs, inverter/panel/battery configurations, earthing resistance, and safety breaker ratings).
3-Stage Workflow Approval Pipeline: Sequential approval workflow across departments—Sales Manager (lead review), Billing Manager (advance security deposit & invoice verification), and O&M/Installation Manager (installation sign-off and service activation).

Billing & Change Process Management (CPM): Dynamic plan upgrading/downgrading with automated debit/credit ledger adjustments, maker-checker approval queues for manual debit/credit notes & payment entries, and multi-ID bulk customer status operations.

Multi-Tier Ticket & Grievance Escalation: Departmental routing (O&M, Billing, Sales, Support) for technical and billing issues with fault code tagging, full audit timelines, and multi-tier escalation tracking (Level-1 to Level-3).

Service Delivery & Inventory Control: Real-time warehouse stock tracking for inverters, panels, batteries, breakers, and cabling with min-stock threshold triggers and movement audit logs.

Analytics & Financial Reporting Engine: High-performance data tables with real-time filtering, summaries, and Excel/CSV export across 6 operational areas (Customer Status, Sales, Receivables, Adjustments, Payments, and Customer Register).

Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Granular access tiers safeguarding sensitive operations for Super Admins, Sales Managers, Billing Managers, O&M Managers, Installation Leads, and Support Specialists.
